story.storyContextArabic: تساعد إيلي ليث على وضع روتين متوازن بين المزرعة والسوق والراحة.
story.storyMissionArabic: يتقدم ليث في قصة الاندماج عبر: روتيني الجديد.

allowedForeshadowing: تفصيل صغير غير مفسر عند الحاجة.

lines.narrationArabic: تساعد إيلي ليث على وضع روتين متوازن بين المزرعة والسوق والراحة.

lines.targetText: Buongiorno, Laith. Cosa fai di solito la mattina?
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Laith. What do you usually do in the morning?
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير يا ليث. What do you usually do in the morning?
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno, Laith. Cosa fai di solito la mattina?

lines.targetText: Buongiorno. Di solito innaffio prima il giardino.
lines.englishReference: Good morning. I usually water the garden first.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. I usually water the garden first.
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno. Di solito innaffio prima il giardino.

lines.englishReference: And what do you do after that?
lines.arabicTranslation: And what do you do after that?

lines.englishReference: Then I help at the market.
lines.arabicTranslation: Then I help at the market.

lines.englishReference: Do you rest in the evening?
lines.arabicTranslation: Do you rest in the evening?

lines.targetText: Sì, leggo o parlo con gli amici.
lines.englishReference: Yes, I read or talk with friends.
lines.arabicTranslation: Yes, I read or talk with friends.
lines.pronunciation: Sì, leggo o parlo con gli amici.

lines.englishReference: That sounds like a good plan.

scenes.promptArabic: انقل مهارة اليوم إلى حياتك: شرح يومك المعتاد.

scenes.purposeArabic: استماع جانبي طبيعي بلا كشف مبكر.

lines.targetText: Il mercato sta cambiando rapidamente in questa stagione.
lines.englishReference: The market is changing quickly this season.
lines.pronunciation: Il mercato sta cambiando rapidamente in questa stagione.

lines.targetText: SÌ. Le persone fanno più domande sulle vecchie strade.
lines.englishReference: Yes. People are asking more questions about old roads.
lines.arabicTranslation: نعم. الناس يسألون أكثر عن الطرق القديمة.
lines.pronunciation: SÌ. Le persone fanno più domande sulle vecchie strade.

scenes.retryPolicy: يعطى المتعلم تلميحًا صغيرًا ثم يعيد المهمة دون عقوبة.
